LaTeX fragment. A LaTeX fragment consists of two strings containing LaTeX commands. The header contains additional header commands to load packages needed for the content (e.g. 
\usepackage{epsfig}
). content conains the actual code to display the specific content. Usually, this will be an 
\input or 
\epsfig
